technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with some trend-following bullish signals, but severe lack of price structure confirmation, volume support, and momentum convergence make this a low-probability entry with high false-signal risk.

fundamental.summary: CPT shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 36 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (301.76), FOMC event today, rising DXY pressures real estate valuations, and credit stress evident; earnings in 36 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) + supertrend bullish + contrarian fear sentiment (15/100) create textbook reversal setup with support at 106.11 nearby.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is crisis-level (VIX 301.76, inverted yield curve, FOMC today, credit stress), price structure is broken (below all major MAs and VWAP), momentum lacks confirmation (no volume, OBV flat, MACD bearish, stoch oversold without cross), and earnings in 36 days create execution risk—false-signal probability is extremely high.
